mandates.thresholdNote: Applies to public procurement contracts above EU procurement thresholds.
mandates.notes: Legal basis: law of 20 December 2017 amending the Public Procurement Law 2012. Accepted formats: Peppol BIS 3.0 (preferred), UBL-OHNL, SI-UBL 2.0 (the Dutch NLCIUS implementation), and SETU (HR-XML) for temporary-staffing invoices specifically.

No B2B mandate exists. Direct quote from the official source: "There is no business-to-business (B2B) mandate." Adoption is voluntary and requires the buyer's consent; no future mandate was announced as of the source's last-updated date.
